text_version.version: JORF n° 305 du 30 décembre 2025, texte n° 20 (JO PDF notified to the Commission as national transposition measure)
text_version.note: The decree exists: official title 'Décret n° 2025-1382 du 29 décembre 2025 relatif à la transposition de la directive (UE) 2023/1791 relative à l'efficacité énergétique' (NOR ECOR2517021D; Légifrance JORFTEXT000053201866). It is a broad EED transposition decree, not data-centre-specific; data-centre provisions are new art. D. 236-1 to D. 236-7 and R. 237-4 to R. 237-6 code de l'énergie (ERF >= 0,20 deemed waste-heat valorisation, threshold may be raised by arrêté). Entry into force per art. 18.

territorial_scope.description: Applies to data centres and energy installations under the French energy and environment codes, with thresholds measured per SIRET number.

evidence.quote: Le présent chapitre s’applique aux centres de données mentionnés à l’article L. 236-1.

summary.short: Transposes parts of EU Directive 2023/1791 on energy efficiency into French energy and environment codes. For data centres above a power threshold, it sets declaration, public reporting and waste-heat reuse duties. In force 1 January 2026.
summary.long: Décret no 2025-1382 transposes parts of EU Directive 2023/1791 on energy efficiency into the energy and environment codes, in force 1 January 2026. For data centres above a power threshold under Art. L. 236-1 of the energy code, operators must declare installed power and a contact to the energy minister, publish annual energy and sustainability data by 15 May, and set up data collection. The energy minister may issue formal notices and fines. Data centres are deemed to reuse waste heat if their ERF is at least 0.20, which may be raised to 0.40 by order. Heat-producing installations must file a cost-benefit analysis unless exempted, and data centres may derogate where technico-economic conditions are not met. Other provisions cover energy audits for large firms, energy performance contracts, public procurement preferences and district heating and cooling criteria.

thresholds.consequence: Installation is not part of the normal operation of a heat network under L. 711-5 II (R. 711-8)
thresholds.conditions: Applies to a heat-production installation intended for peak demand; the project holder must submit a note showing no alternative can be implemented under acceptable technical and economic conditions

evidence.quote: Dans ce second cas, l’installation est exploitée moins de 500 heures par an

thresholds.variable_text: coût de modification d’une installation de réseau de chaleur, rapporté au coût d’une installation neuve comparable
thresholds.value_text: excède 50 % du coût d’investissement d’une installation neuve comparable
thresholds.measurement: cost of the modification compared with the investment cost of a comparable new installation
thresholds.consequence: Modification qualified as a modification d’ampleur (major modification) for the purposes of L. 711-5 III (R. 711-9)
thresholds.conditions: Applies for the purposes of L. 711-5 III

evidence.quote: la modification d’une installation est qualifiée de modification d’ampleur si son coût excède 50 % du coût d’investissement d’une installation neuve comparable
